steps: Create an account and connect your channel
Choose a plan, topic and language
landing.shareScope: 30% applies only to revenue from videos created inside our ecosystem and published through it. Revenue from other videos on your channel is excluded.
landing.shareDetails: Terms are recorded in your agreement. Subscription fees are separate. Revenue depends on video performance and YouTube policies; earnings are not guaranteed.

faqs.a: Yes. You control your channel and grant connection permissions. You can revoke access.

faqs.q: Is the fee on my whole channel?
faqs.a: No. The platform’s 30% share applies only to videos created and published through the ecosystem. Other videos are excluded.

faqs.q: Can I choose my content language?
faqs.a: Settings include a catalog of 30 language variants. Voice generation availability depends on the connected provider.
Content goes through moderation before publication. Material requiring corrections is returned for revision.

landing.ctaText: Create a profile, explore the tools and set up a workspace for your channel.
landing.footer: One workspace for creating and managing YouTube content.

planning.title: Content plan
planning.explanation: Suggestions use videos found on YouTube. Times follow your preferences, not unverified audience activity claims. Review and approve selected videos before generation starts.
planning.failed: The plan could not be prepared. Check provider and channel configuration.
planning.useMonthlyBudget: Plan this month within my budget
planning.budgetEstimate: Capacity uses the per-video spending ceiling. Actual cost varies by model, duration and revisions; credit is checked again before generation.

modelCatalog.title: AI model prices
modelCatalog.note: Video generation is billed per second. Credits are platform balance, not model tokens. Voice, scripts and revisions also consume credit.
